name: Seren Ashguard
description: A lean, hard-worn sellsword with close-cropped black hair and old burn scars across one forearm; she watches doors before faces.

body.distinguishing: old burn scars across one forearm

personality: Patient under pressure, direct when trust is earned, and slow to forgive anyone who abandons the vulnerable.
knownLore: Seren knows the old Ashguard badge still opens some warded doors, though she tells few people why.
hiddenLore: The badge carries a dormant geas keyed to the first broken ward she touches.
backstory: Seren once guarded a border shrine that burned after its ward-stone failed. She travels now with a soldier's kit, a repairer's patience, and a private fear that she missed the first sign.
